note: CLN3-associated retinopathies prominently display electronegative ERGs as well as undetectable/absent responses across multiple independent cohorts.

evidence.text: In children presenting with CLN3 disease, dark-adapted full-field ERG responses were either electronegative or completely absent/undetectable.

source.title: Recognizing differentiating clinical signs of CLN3 disease (Batten disease) at presentation
source.quote: In CLN3 disease, dark-adapted (DA) full-field electroretinogram (ERG) responses were either absent or electronegative.

evidence.text: Among 8 children with CLN3 disease, 4 (50%) demonstrated an electronegative ERG while the remaining 4 had undetectable ERG responses.

source.title: Early recognition of CLN3 disease facilitated by visual electrophysiology and multimodal imaging
source.quote: Electronegative ERGs were identified in all patients.
